profile.headline: 🧳Software Engineer II @ Booz Allen Hamilton | 🎓 Master’s Student in Computer Science @ Georgia Tech
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer passionate about solving complex technical challenges, building scalable cloud-native solutions, and driving mission success. Currently pursuing my Master of Science in Computer Science at Georgia Tech, I am expanding my expertise in advanced computing, complex network architectures, and knowledge-based AI to complement my aerospace background with modern software engineering practices.

My experience centers on building containerized applications and orchestrating robust CI/CD pipelines. I specialize in developing Kubernetes-based applications focused on automated post-deployment testing, system validation, and seamless interaction across cluster components. By leveraging Helm, ArgoCD, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), I streamline deployment workflows and enhance system observability, calculating and exposing critical telemetry metrics through Prometheus and custom Grafana dashboards.

With a solid technical foundation, I bring a unique analytical perspective to software development. Alongside my cloud and DevOps work, my background includes building UI/UX prototypes, and utilizing AWS cloud environments to deliver well-rounded, resilient software solutions.
🔹 Specialties: Software Engineering, Kubernetes & Containerization, CI/CD Pipelines (Helm, ArgoCD), Systems Observability (Prometheus, Grafana), Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Cloud Computing (AWS Certified Developer – Associate)
🔹 Currently exploring: Advanced cloud architectures, automated deployment strategies, and AI applications
Always open to connecting with fellow engineers, technologists, and innovators.
